title: The Lord on High Proclaims
description: The Lord on High Proclaims in Tonic Solfa to FRANCONIA, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book I, collected from the Scriptures, hymn 85, headed “The same”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to FRANCONIA; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: The Lord on high pro-claims His God-head from his throne; "Mer-cy and jus-tice are the names "By which I will be known.

lines: "Look from the borders of the pit
God will pronounce the sinners just,
And take the saints to heaven.

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to FRANCONIA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
